crossRefs.note: With the pure you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.
God who is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who has hardened himself against him and prospered?
With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.
But they rebelled and grieved his Holy Spirit. Therefore he turned and became their enemy, and he himself fought…

translations.web: then I will also walk contrary to you; and I will strike you, even I, seven times for your sins.
translations.bsb: then I will act with hostility toward you, and I will strike you sevenfold for your sins.
translations.kjv: Then will I also walk contrary unto you, and will punish you yet seven times for your sins.
translations.asv: then will I also walk contrary unto you; and I will smite you, even I, seven times for your sins.
